scripts.dev:back: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint:back: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed --reset
scripts.db:cleanup-demo: cd backend && uv run python -m app.cleanup_demo
